headword: {賃貸住宅|ちんたいじゅうたく}

definitions.explanation: Housing that is rented rather than owned. Encompasses apartments, houses, and other dwellings available for lease.

examples.japanese: {賃貸住宅|ちんたいじゅうたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{賃貸住宅|ちんたいじゅうたく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This area has a lot of rental housing.

examples.japanese: {賃貸住宅|ちんたいじゅうたく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けられない→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: Since I live in rental housing, I can't make holes in the walls.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{賃貸|ちんたい}→賃貸：06081_chintai⟧ (rental, lease) + ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧ (housing, residence). A formal term commonly used in real estate listings, contracts, and housing discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {賃貸住宅|ちんたいじゅうたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to search for rental housing
- {賃貸住宅|ちんたいじゅうたく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live in rental housing
- {賃貸住宅|ちんたいじゅうたく}⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧: rental housing management
- ⟦{公営|こうえい}→公営：22485_kouei⟧{賃貸住宅|ちんたいじゅうたく}: public rental housing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{賃貸|ちんたい}→賃貸：06081_chintai⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧: rental apartment building — specifically refers to a condominium-style building
- ⟦{借家|しゃくや}→借家：29494_shakuya⟧: rented house — more colloquial, typically refers to a standalone house
- ⟦{分譲住宅|ぶんじょうじゅうたく}→分譲住宅：23884_bunjoujuutaku⟧: housing for sale — the opposite, housing sold to individual owners

USAGE:
In everyday conversation, the abbreviation ⟦{賃貸|ちんたい}→賃貸：06081_chintai⟧ is often used alone, especially in real estate contexts (e.g., ⟦{賃貸|ちんたい}→賃貸：06081_chintai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧ means "to search for rentals").
